# Simplekpi

Beautifully simple KPI software. Create, manage and analyse your Key Performance Indicators from the cloud.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/simplekpi/.

## Actions

- **Add User KPI**: Assign a KPI to a user in SimpleKPI.
- **Batch KPI Entries**: Batch create or update multiple KPI entries at once.
- **Create Category KPI**: Create a new KPI within a category in SimpleKPI.
- **Create KPI**: Create a new KPI with specified configuration.
- **Create KPI Category**: Create a new KPI category in SimpleKPI.
- **Create User**: Create a new user account in SimpleKPI.
- **Get All Data Entries** (read-only): Retrieve processed KPI data entries for reports including calculated KPIs.
- **Get KPI by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific KPI by ID from SimpleKPI.
- **Get KPI Entry** (read-only): Retrieve a specific KPI entry by ID.
- **Get User by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific user by ID.
- **List All KPIs** (read-only): Retrieve all KPIs from a SimpleKPI account.
- **List Category KPIs** (read-only): Retrieve all KPIs within a specific category.
- **List Groups** (read-only): Retrieve all groups from SimpleKPI.
- **List KPI Categories** (read-only): Get all KPI categories.
- **List KPI Entries** (read-only): Get all KPI entries filtered by date range and optional criteria.
- **List User KPIs** (read-only): Get all KPIs assigned to a specific user.
- **Add User Group Item**: Assign a group item to a user in SimpleKPI.
- **Create Group**: Create a new group in SimpleKPI.
- **Create Group Item**: Create a new item within a group in SimpleKPI.
- **Create KPI Unit**: Create a new KPI unit in SimpleKPI.
- **Delete Category KPI**: Delete a KPI from a category.
- **Delete Group**: Delete a group by ID.
- **Delete Group Item**: Delete a group item by ID.
- **Delete KPI**: Delete a KPI by ID.
- **Delete KPI Category**: Delete a KPI category by its ID.
- **Delete KPI Entry**: Delete a KPI entry by ID.
- **Delete KPI Unit**: Delete a KPI unit by its ID.
- **Delete User**: Delete a user account by ID.
- **Delete User Group Item**: Remove a group item assignment from a user.
- **Delete User KPI**: Remove a KPI assignment from a user.
- **Get Category KPI** (read-only): Retrieve a specific KPI within a category.
- **Get Group** (read-only): Get a specific group by ID from SimplekPI.
- **Get Group Item** (read-only): Retrieve a specific group item by ID.
- **Get KPI Category** (read-only): Get a specific KPI category by ID from SimpleKPI.
- **Get KPI Frequency** (read-only): Get a specific KPI frequency by ID from SimplekPI.
- **Get KPI Icon by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific KPI icon by ID.
- **Get KPI Unit** (read-only): Get a specific KPI unit by ID from SimpleKPI.
- **Get User Group Item** (read-only): Get a specific group item assigned to a user.
- **Get User KPI** (read-only): Retrieve a specific KPI assigned to a user.
- **List All KPI Units** (read-only): Retrieve all KPI units from a SimpleKPI account.
- **List Group Items** (read-only): Get all items within a group.
- **List KPI Frequencies** (read-only): Get all KPI frequencies.
- **List KPI Icons** (read-only): Retrieve all KPI icons from SimpleKPI.
- **List User Group Items** (read-only): Get all group items assigned to a user.
- **Update Category KPI**: Update a KPI within a category.
- **Update Group**: Update an existing group in SimpleKPI.
- **Update Group Item**: Update an existing item in a SimpleKPI group.
- **Update KPI**: Update an existing KPI in SimpleKPI.
- **Update KPI Entry**: Update an existing KPI entry in SimpleKPI.
- **Update KPI Unit**: Update an existing KPI unit in SimpleKPI.
- **Update User**: Update an existing user account in SimpleKPI.
